meta.name: baoyu-electron-extract
meta.description: Extracts resources and JavaScript from any installed Electron app (`.asar` bundle), restoring original sources from `.js.map` files when available or formatting minified code with Prettier otherwise. Use when user wants to "extract Electron app", "decompile Electron", "get the source code of <app>", "inspect app.asar", "看 Electron 应用源码", "提取 .asar", or asks how a desktop Electron app is built. Skips `node_modules` and supports both macOS and Windows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取 Electron 应用的源码和资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想查看或分析某个 Electron 桌面应用的内部实现
copy.tagline_en: Extract source code and resources from Electron apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to inspect or analyze the internals of an Electron desktop app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能提取已安装 Electron 应用的 app.asar 包:有 .js.map 就还原原始源码树,否则用 Prettier 格式化压缩代码,并跳过 node_modules。支持 macOS 和 Windows。
howto.when: 当你提到「提取 Electron 应用」「反编译 Electron」「看 Electron 应用源码」等说法,或想查看某个桌面 Electron 应用怎么构建时触发。输入可以是应用名或绝对路径。

say.note: 默认输出到下载目录,可用 --output 改

say.text: 先跑一次 --dry-run 看会解析出哪些路径

howto.what_en: Claude extracts resources and JavaScript from an installed Electron app's app.asar: with a .js.map it rebuilds the original sources, otherwise it formats minified code with Prettier, skipping node_modules. macOS and Windows.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "extract Electron app", "decompile Electron", or "look at the source of <app>". Accepts an app name or absolute path.

say_en.note: Locates the app by absolute path

say_en.text: Run a --dry-run first to see resolved paths
